FOLLOW_COLLECTION_SUBMIT: All found · hand them in from Prestige
FILTERS_TOOLTIP: Filter the gear grid. Closing Filters shows every item again.
FILTERS_HINT: The gear grid shows only this category while Filters is open. Closing it shows every item again.
SUPPLY_CAPACITY_NOTE: Supply slots: one per supply type (%d types). Filters sit next to the gear count.
SUPPLY_MASTERY_EXPLAIN: Supplies are spent when used, but their mastery is permanent: every copy you find (drops and offline earnings) adds ^1, up to ^%d, and using one never lowers it. Prestige keeps mastery; Hard Reset clears it. Copies bought with coins add stock only.
SUPPLY_AUTO_RULE_HEAL: Auto-use: at %s%% HP or below, after the cooldown
SUPPLY_AUTO_RULE_COINS: Auto-use: whenever it is not active
SUPPLY_AUTO_RULE_GUARD: Auto-use: during combat, when not active
SUPPLY_AUTO_RULE_RECOVERY: Auto-use: at %s%% HP or below, when not active
SUPPLY_AUTO_RULE_XP: Auto-use: whenever it is not active
SUPPLY_EFFECT_HEAL: Heals %s%% of max HP (%s HP now) · cooldown %s s · usable at %s%% HP or below
SUPPLY_EFFECT_COINS: +%s%% coins from defeated enemies for %s s
SUPPLY_EFFECT_GUARD: +%s Defense (%s%% less damage taken) for %s s
SUPPLY_EFFECT_RECOVERY: Heals %s%% of max HP per second for %s s (%s%% in total) · usable below %s%% HP
SUPPLY_EFFECT_XP: +%s%% XP from defeated enemies for %s s
SUPPLY_HP_HIGH: Your HP is too high for this supply.
SUPPLY_COOLDOWN: The potion is still cooling down.
SUPPLY_ACTIVE: Already active. Use it again when it runs out.
SUPPLY_NO_MERGE: Supplies grow by themselves: every copy found raises mastery.
TELEPORT_HELP: Choose another camp you own, on this map or a map you have reached. Teleporting is blocked during combat.
TELEPORT_NONE: No other camp yet. Unlock another camp to teleport there.
PRESTIGE_KEEP: Cards and sets, boss keys, enemy achievements, every upgrade bought with gems (all categories), automation, inventory space, supply mastery and settings.
PRESTIGE_RESET: Coins, gems, items (supply stock included) and merges, level, camps, map exploration, coin upgrades and unfinished challenges.
